fix.notes: Purely additive change — one new attribute on the view object and one new template line inside an already-guarded block. No logic changes, no DB queries, no auth impact.
fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong The `/admin/archetypes` search page showed matching decks in a table but gave no indication of how many were found, making it hard to gauge search scope at a glance. ## What changed - `decksite/views/archetype_search.py`: Added `self.search_result_count = len(search_results)` alongside the existing `has_search_results` flag. - `decksite/templates/archetypesearch.mustache`: Added `

{{search_result_count}} decks found

` inside the `{{#has_search_results}}` block, displayed above the results table. ## Validation - `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed. - Unit tests require a live database not available in this environment; there are no existing DB-free tests for `ArchetypeSearch` and the change is too trivial (one attribute assignment, one template interpolation) to warrant a new one. Fixes #11887
fix.pr_title: Show total deck count on /admin/archetypes search results (#11887)
